853:t_72:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aah... 'Flatfoot' is youth slang for the greatest warrior!」

853:t_72:11.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I see... Then that is acceptable.」

853:t_72:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That was close... Why do these god types overreact so much to the word 'flatfoot'...?)

853:t_73:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Haha... This is embarrassing. Being an ace isn't really my style.」

853:t_73:5.en:
$$青山$$
「You're right. An ace office worker does sound a little strange.」

853:t_73:6.en:
$$いぶき$$
「If you're getting something, wouldn't you prefer a promotion to a title?」

853:t_73:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And here's an extra one! Happy Section Chief Pilot!」

853:t_73:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「Hmm... Those are so realistic that I don't really feel praised...」

853:t_73:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Should I have dreamed big and called you 'President,' at least on an occasion like this?」

853:t_73:12.en:
$$青山$$
「If you did that, $$ＡＧ$$, you'd sound like a tout in the nightlife district.」

853:t_74:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$, though that title is hardly one I wanted.」

853:t_74:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand how you feel. But what Earth needs now is the strength to defeat its enemies.」

853:t_74:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You may not like it, $$ロジャー$$, but as a member of $c, you should first use your strength to face the crisis before us.」

853:t_74:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Sound reasoning coupled with flattery... You are quite an eloquent speaker.」

853:t_74:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Perhaps. If you let me repaint your body entirely black, I could take you on as my assistant.」

853:t_74:11.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Then we'd have the worst duo ever.」

853:t_75:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「You... How about teaming up with me?」

853:t_75:8.en:
$$ベック$$
「You bet. I figure you and me together could pull off something even bigger.」

853:t_75:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is a very appealing offer, but...」

853:t_75:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... actually don't like working under anyone.」

853:t_75:11.en:
$$ベック$$
「I knew it! That's probably why I sensed a kindred spirit in you!」

853:t_75:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But with you, I might be able to build an equal partnership.」

853:t_75:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When this war is over, I'll give your offer serious consideration, $$ベック$$.」

853:t_76:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「But no matter how many enemies I alone shoot down, it won't change the course of the war.」

853:t_76:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's true. In your case, $$宗介$$, there's one target you'd rather bring down than a hundred run-of-the-mill enemies.」

853:t_76:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do you mean an enemy ace?」

853:t_76:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... In terms of toughness, I think the target is their equal... or even tougher.」

853:t_76:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In fact, you've taken quite a barrage in your encounters so far, $$宗介$$.」

853:t_76:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you mean $$千鳥$$'s paper fan, I don't mind it. That's... our way of communicating.」

853:t_76:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「I do think about my relationship with $$千鳥$$, in my own way.」

853:t_76:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is admirable. Allow me to sincerely congratulate you on your personal growth, $$宗介$$.」

853:t_77:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You don't have to tell me that now. The title I want is something else entirely.」

853:t_77:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is it the position of $c's number-one sniper?」

853:t_77:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I took that a long time ago. What I want is...」

853:t_77:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To put it plainly... You want to be the ace of the bedroom!」

853:t_77:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You get it! I knew I could count on you, $$ＡＧ$$!」

853:t_77:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I can also see that talk like that will make the target who truly matters get fed up with you.」

853:t_77:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...You're right. We've been through one huge battle after another...」

853:t_77:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'll take a serious shot myself too.」

853:t_78:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Never mind the congratulations. Hurry up and hand over my extra prize: a year's supply of beer.」

853:t_78:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait a minute! When did anyone decide on that extra prize!?」

853:t_78:6.en:
$$マオ$$
「When? Just now! Who? Me! Got any complaints?」

853:t_78:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if I'm paying for it out of my own pocket, I'm joining you for a drink too!」

853:t_78:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「Sure. Drinking with you should be fun.」

853:t_78:11.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's do this, $$ＡＧ$$! Come to my room in full protective gear!」

853:t_78:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait...! Are your drinking parties as dangerous as a battlefield, $$マオ$$!?」

853:t_78:13.en:
$$マオ$$
「One lewd word earns you one bullet. One act of sexual harassment earns you a whole carton of magazines... Come over when you're ready for that.」

853:t_79:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But please don't give up hope. It isn't all over yet.」

853:t_80:4.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So, do you have the item we discussed...?」

853:t_80:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have it ready. That anime disc you requested, $$クルーゾー$$, said to be the oldest masterpiece...」

853:t_80:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But since it is so old, it hasn't been dubbed into the standard language...」

853:t_80:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I don't mind. I've fully mastered Old Japanese so I can appreciate works like that.」

853:t_80:8.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Now I've gained the confidence to make a living as a professional in that field.」

853:t_80:10.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Then, excuse me. I'm taking the next ten hours entirely for myself.」
